newsitem.title: MEXICO: Telmex, GCarso to offer 5.7 bln pesos comm'l paper.
newsitem.headline: Telmex, GCarso to offer 5.7 bln pesos comm'l paper.

text.p: Mexican telephone giant Telmex, its holding company Grupo Carso and Carso subsidiaries announced Wednesday plans to issue more than 5.7 billion pesos of commercial paper from Thursday.
In advertisements published in national media, Telmex said it will offer 3 billion pesos of commercial paper. The issue was registered with the Mexican Stock Exchange on Wednesday.
Carso and various of its subsidiaries also announced commercial paper offerings. Carso itself will launch two issues of 1.3 billion pesos and 560 million pesos.
Carso's key unit, Carso Global Telecom, said it will float 630 million pesos in commercial paper.
Also, Carso's restaurant chain Sanborn Hermanos announced a commercial paper issue of 150 million pesos. Its tire company Euzdaki said it will offer 90 million pesos.
